reference_title: 물속 다리 기둥을 세운 천재적인 해결법, 코퍼댐 공법의 진화
deliverables_per_topic: topics/<slug>/brief.md: principle, accuracy guards, story beats, shot table
topics/<slug>/narration.txt: exact Piljae TTS text only
topics/<slug>/title-description.txt: 3 Shorts title options, description, hashtags, final script
topics/<slug>/topic.json: clips, draft timeline, caption keywords, topic guards
topics/<slug>/narration.en.txt: exact English TTS text only, one line per Korean sentence
topics/<slug>/title-description.en.txt: English title options, description, hashtags, final English script
outputs/<slug>-final.mp4, outputs/<slug>.srt, outputs/<slug>-verification.json (local only, not in Git)
outputs/<slug>-final-en.mp4, outputs/<slug>.en.srt (English set, same picture edit; local only, not in Git)

voice.voice_id_rule: always re-resolve from the authenticated /v3/voices catalog; never hard-code

length_budget.rule: if raw Piljae audio exceeds the budget, shorten the script and regenerate; never speed it up and never let atrim cut speech
length_budget.estimate: about 6.5 Korean characters (spaces excluded) per raw second; checkvalve 292 chars = 44.6 s

language_sets.rule: every topic ships a Korean set (Piljae TTS + Korean captions/titles) and an English set (English TTS + English captions/titles) built on the same picture edit and sound design
language_sets.picture_master: ko: Blender keyframes and clip timelines follow the Korean Piljae timing.json; the English set reuses that picture unchanged

voice_en.character: smooth, calm, explanatory adult male English narrator (user 2026-10-11)
voice_en.voice_id_rule: resolve by English name from the authenticated /v3/voices catalog (original, ssfm-v30); never hard-code; list candidates with connect-typecast.ps1 -ListVoices -Gender male -UseCase 'E-learning/Explainer'

postprocess.sentence_placement: cut the English take at its sentence silences and start each English sentence at the matching Korean sentence start from work/<slug>/timing.json, so the shared picture stays in sync; a line that would run past the next Korean start may start earlier into the preceding pause (keep >= 0.35 s after the previous English line and >= 0.25 s before the next Korean start)

length_budget.rule: each English sentence (after rate) must end before the next Korean sentence starts; the last one must end at least payoff_tail_seconds_min before the video end; if not, shorten that English line and regenerate; never speed it up and never cut speech
length_budget.estimate: about 3.6 English syllables per raw second for a calm narrator

voice_en.writing_rule: original English adaptation of each Korean line, same facts and beat order; hook reaction word (e.g. 'insane') must land near the Korean punch-in cue

immersion_structure: 0-2 s visual hook: the most impressive moment of the process, already moving
2-5 s open loop: a spoken question answered only near the end
improved solution with a slowed, close-up 'satisfying' moment
payoff line that answers the open loop
loop ending whose last frame matches the first frame

style.look: realistic detailed engineering CGI, PBR materials, AgX, ambient occlusion, beveled edges
style.priority: viewer engagement and accurate meaningful motion before credit minimization
style.motion_rule: no static hold over 1 s; a new shot or a clear state change at least every 3 s
style.scale_cues: always include a known-size object (person, car, tugboat) in wide shots
style.composition: short white/yellow title and compact progress chip near 30 percent screen height; meaningful moving mechanism in context; captions near 65 percent screen height

layout.reason: 2026-10-11 user: text too high is hard to read across phones; gather title and captions nearer the center
rules: keep all title, chip and caption ink inside the central reading bands; no text in the top 500 px, bottom 540 px or right button column
picture is full-bleed 1080x1920; these zones guide overlay placement and framing, never crop the whole mechanism into a narrow window
center each line horizontally on x=540; use at most 74 percent frame width including outline
use a short one-line title and compact chip inside the title band; shrink or reword before moving text toward screen edges
keep the caption block centered on y=1260; one line and two lines share the same block center
reaction and keyword emphasis use color and sound within the same size and position limits
conservative production margins are not universal phone safe-area specifications; verify actual output with UI masks and multiple display aspect ratios

horizontal_centering.rule: every title, progress chip, caption line and the picture window is horizontally centered on x=540 with symmetric left/right margins
horizontal_centering.verify: after the final render, measure the non-background bounding box of title and caption rows on start, middle and end frames; |left margin - right margin| <= 2 px, else fix and re-render

layout.phone_check: check first, middle, last and longest two-line caption at 360 px width; use top 500 px, bottom 540 px and right button mask; review centered 9:16, 9:19.5 and 9:20 display simulations without changing output aspect ratio

captions.timing_source: Whisper on final hosted Piljae audio
captions.style: white bold Korean text with dark outline on a plain dark lower panel; topic keywords in yellow
captions.vertical_anchor: one-line or two-line block vertically centered at y=1260; ink and outline remain inside y=1140-1380

captions_en.timing_source: Whisper on final English narration audio
captions_en.style: same panel, outline and size as the Korean captions; topic keywords (topic.json caption_keywords_en) in yellow
captions_en.on_screen_titles: English titles and progress chips from topic.json (progress_chips_en, shot titles_en); no Korean text in the English set
captions_en.vertical_anchor: one-line or two-line block vertically centered at y=1260; ink and outline remain inside y=1140-1380

native_edit.audio_input: premixed Piljae plus quiet original sound design; Whisper uses the clean Piljae file

guards: resolve actual Piljae voice_id from authenticated API catalog
measure final speech before visual generation
show the current Higgsfield and Typecast cost and balance and get user approval before any paid generation
one approved mechanism asset reused across clips
no generated speech or baked text in raw clips
Korean (ko set) and English (en set) labels and captions added in post
never retry an unknown submission automatically
original spoken text; never copy reference wording
explain the generic method; do not claim a specific project's numbers unless verified
never silently replace the chosen English narrator; show its cost and get approval before generation like Piljae
